preconditions.expression: isinstance(head, ListNode) and head is not None
preconditions.description: The input is a non-empty singly linked list represented by a ListNode object.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(getattr(head, 'val', None), int) and isinstance(getattr(head, 'next', None), ListNode) for head in [head] + [getattr(head, 'next', None)] if getattr(head, 'next', None) is not None)
preconditions.description: Each node in the linked list has an integer value and a next pointer to the next node.

preconditions.expression: all(head.val < head.next.val for head in [head] + [getattr(head, 'next', None)] if getattr(head, 'next', None) is not None)
preconditions.description: The linked list is sorted in ascending order.

postconditions.description: The function returns a TreeNode object which is the root of the constructed Balanced Binary Search Tree.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value.val == expected_value for expected_value, node in zip(expected_preorder, preorder_traversal(return_value)) if node is not None)
postconditions.description: The preorder traversal of the constructed BST matches the preorder traversal of the linked list.
